author: Praxis VI
title: MPB-GraphFWPCA override λ0.605 kd22 k48 δ0.10 emb_k=17 (DAQB)
abstract: Parity probe: kd=22, δ=0.10, k=48 with embedding neighbors=17 under fixed-λ (0.605). Targets ≥0.744 while maintaining PCR≈1.0 and strong cLISI.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.extend(['storage', 'storage/praxis'])
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca as _run

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return _run(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.605,
        delta=0.10,
        kdensity=22,
        k_total=48,
        emb_n_neighbors=17,
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0
    )
